mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals strengthening economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the quarters where real GDP growth increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a slowing economy.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where industrial production declines by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% month-over-month signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it indicates a robust economy.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where housing starts increase by more than 5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a slowing economy.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls decrease by more than 100,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a tightening monetary environment with high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and housing starts increase by more than 5% month-over-month, it signals a strong demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity accelerates.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 positive and HOUST increase > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where real GDP growth is positive and housing starts increase by more than 5% within a month.
